anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: search the scriptures… they bear witness about me.

pass_a_gloss: we have found the sacred and lawful writings not having kept silent but compelling us the fulfillment of the commandments that came to be, being completed into us according to the thing said: Search the writings in which you have life in them, and those bear witness about me.
pass_b_english: we have found the sacred and lawful scriptures not keeping silent, but compelling us to the fulfillment of the commandments that came to be, being completed in us according to what was said: "Search the scriptures, in which you have life in them, and they bear witness about me."
source_text: εὕραμεν τὰς [ἱ]ερὰς καὶ ἐνθέσμους γραφὰς οὐ παρασιωπησά<ς> ἀλλὰ|| ἀναγκαζούσας ἡμᾶς τὴν περὶ τῶν γενομένων ἐντολῶν ἐκπλήρωσιν, εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐκτελουμένας κ[α]τὰ τὸ εἰρημένον· "Ζητεῖτ[ε] τὰς γραφὰς ἐν αἷς ζωὴν ἔχετε ἐν αὐταῖς κἀκεῖναι μαρ[τυρο]ῦσιν περὶ ἐμοῦ".
